titre: Devoir de contrôle n°1 - Anglais (8ème année de base)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
My uncle Karim is a doctor. He is forty years old and he works in a big hospital in Tunis. He is a tall man with black hair and kind brown eyes. Every day, he helps many sick people and he never complains, even when he is tired. He always has a smile on his face. In his free time, my uncle likes reading and gardening. He grows beautiful roses in his garden. He is generous and helpful: last month, he took care of a poor old man for free. I admire my uncle very much and I want to be like him when I grow up.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (8 marks)
1) What is uncle Karim's job and where does he work?   (2 marks)
2) Give two words that describe his physical appearance.   (2 marks)
3) What does he like doing in his free time?   (2 marks)
4) Why does the writer admire his uncle?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with the present simple: My uncle (help) ______ many sick people.   (1,5 marks)
2) Give the comparative of "tall": My uncle is ______ than my father.   (1,5 marks)
3) Give the opposite of "generous" = ______.   (1,5 marks)
4) Complete with an adverb of frequency (always / never): He ______ complains.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (6 marks)
Write about a person you admire (a member of your family, a teacher, a hero…) in about 8 lines. Describe his/her appearance and character, and say why you admire him/her. Use the present simple.
